data.name: Nil
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nil is a name of the goddess of the Nile river. The name Nil is derived from the Greek word 'nilos' which means 'valley' or 'river'. In the context of Christianity, Nil is not explicitly mentioned in the Bible. However, the name could be seen as a nod to the biblical figure Noah, whose name also means 'rest' or 'comfort'.
